sources.title: Nvidia investigates CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with alleged Chinese spy
sources.text: Nvidia has opened an investigation into co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with a businesswoman who intelligence agencies say is a Chinese spy. U.S. intelligence agencies have expressed concerns that the woman, Alice Huang, who is affiliated with a cloud company and an Nvidia customer called Megaspeed, has been passing information to Beijing, according to reports in The New York Times and the Financial Times. Huang told Nvidia staff in an email on Sunday that he had an affair with the woman and that Nvidia's board of directors had opened an independent investigation into the spying allegations. "I was unfaithful to my wife. My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did," Huang wrote in the message. "I am deeply sorry." An Nvidia spokesperson said that Huang was committed to continuing as CEO of Nvidia without interruption. In a statement, the Nvidia board said it would investigate the allegations that Huang had been the target of a foreign intelligence effort. "While the Board has no reason to believe that either national security or NVIDIA secrets were compromised, the Board's inquiry will examine all available information," Nvidia's board said in a statement. Read Huang's email to Nvidia employees and the company board of directors' statement here . The allegations come as Nvidia has become the center of a trade dispute between China and the U.S. as AI is seen as increasingly critical to national security. The U.S. restricts exports of Nvidia's most advanced AI chips to China, though it has approved exports of certain older, slower models. Megaspeed, which Ms. Huang is affiliated with, has been accused of helping restricted Chinese companies acquire Nvidia AI chips. Nvidia representatives previously said that Megaspeed had already been investigated for evading export controls. Nvidia's Huang has pushed for broader AI chip exports to China, saying it is better for the U.S. if the world uses and builds on American technology. He has also aligned with President Donald Trump on American artificial intelligence policy and its infrastructure buildout. In his note to staff, Huang said he was "proud and grateful" to be an American. Three House Republican committee chairs sent a letter to Huang on Wednesday asking him to sit for a closed-door briefing with lawmakers on Nov. 18. Nvidia reports third-quarter earnings on Nov. 17 and will hold a major conference in Washington, D.C., at the end of the month.

sources.title: The Pentagon is reportedly ramping up economic warfare and espionage. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with a suspected Chinese spy shows why
sources.text: AI chip leader Nvidia launched an investigation into reports CEO Jensen Huang was the target of a foreign intelligence campaign—just as the U.S. has intensified its own efforts at economic warfare. Nvidia’s board released a statement Sunday that a committee of independent directors and an outside counsel will oversee the probe, adding that Huang supports the review and plans to cooperate. “The Board prioritizes U.S. national and economic security, which is paramount to the interests of NVIDIA and its shareholders,” it said. “While the Board has no reason to believe that either national security or NVIDIA secrets were compromised, the Board’s inquiry will examine all available information.” The announcement followed reports that Huang had a romantic relationship with Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, whom U.S. intelligence suspects was working as a spy for China. According to the New York Times and Financial Times , the Nvidia boss admitted to the affair and apologized in an internal message to company employees. “I was unfaithful to my wife. My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry,” he said in the message. Representatives for Nvidia and Megaspeed didn’t immediately respond to requests for comment. U.S. officials believe Alice Huang was recruited by China’s Ministry of State Security, sources told the FT , and surveillance revealed that she was feeding information to China, according to the New York Times . Jensen Huang, who isn’t related to Alice, is a central figure in the U.S. AI industry, leading a company that develops world-class chips powering large language models. Its technology is so sensitive that the Trump administration has restricted exports of Nvidia’s most cutting-edge products to China while President Donald Trump has often cited the U.S.-China AI rivalry as a reason for not slowing down development. Meanwhile, Megaspeed is a Singapore-based data center company that quickly became one of Nvidia’s top customers in Asia, purchasing more than $4.8 billion in chips over the past two years. But the U.S. also investigated Megaspeed last year for allegedly helping smuggle restricted AI chips into China, which the company has denied. News of the Nvidia’s probe into Huang comes weeks after reports indicated the U.S. defense and intelligence communities are getting more aggressive about industrial espionage. Sources told the Washington Post that the Pentagon is planning a spying program that deploys “nonofficial cover officers” who pose as executives—a covert effort in a larger economic warfare campaign. Politico also reported that the Defense Department is quietly building an elite agency to covertly sabotage foreign technology programs that could threaten U.S. military superiority. The Technology Support Office was established in April by reorganizing two classified intelligence programs that have been secretly carrying out technology sabotage at a smaller scale since 2023. “This query appears to be built on information that is simply not true. Whoever is feeding you these claims are either badly misinformed or deliberately leading you astray to peddle their fantasies,” it told both outlets. But other signs point to the U.S. taking economic warfare more seriously. In September, CIA Deputy Director Michael Ellis said the U.S. is expanding espionage against China by targeting companies in sensitive areas like AI, biotechnology and chips. Also this year, the Pentagon formed the Economic Defense Unit for “deterring, denying, disrupting, and helping to defeat adversaries through economic means,” sources told DefenseScoop . AI in particular has emerged as such an important technology that the Defense Department has been more heavy-handed with U.S. companies as well. Anthropic’s AI models were used in the military, but a dispute between the San Francisco-based startup and top brass led to a schism just as the Iran war started. CEO Dario Amodei has said the company is patriotic and seeks to defend the U.S ., but wouldn’t allow its AI to be used in mass domestic surveillance or autonomous weapons. The Pentagon insisted it would use the AI in lawful scenarios and refused to abide by any limits from the company that would go beyond those constraints. After failing to reach a compromise earlier this year, Trump ordered the Pentagon to phase out Anthropic’s technology. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth also designated the company a supply-chain risk, meaning contractors can’t use it for military work. Last month, an appeals court ruled the supply-chain risk designation is illegal, but the Pentagon confirmed it’s no longer using any Anthropic tools.

sources.text: Nvidia’s board of directors announced Sunday that it’s launching an independent investigation following reports that CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by a Chinese spy operation . Nvidia also published a message that Huang sent to the company admitting that he had an affair with Alice Huang, a former executive at Singapore-based chip company Megaspeed (though he didn’t mention her by name). A memo circulating among U.S. policymakers earlier this year claimed that Alice Huang had been recruited by China’s Ministry of State Security to spy on Nvidia’s CEO. “I owe my family and all of you an apology,” Jensen Huang wrote. “I was unfaithful to my wife. My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry.” Huang added that he’d “fallen short” of his responsibility to the company. “To my colleagues at NVIDIA, including those I have worked alongside for decades, and to our board, partners, and shareholders around the world: you deserve better from me,” he said. As the AI race between the United States and China heats up , chips, especially Nvidia’s chips, have been a major focus . Huang also seems to have a close relationship with President Donald Trump , who’s been a cheerleader of the AI ( or “superintelligence” ) industry. In its announcement, Nvidia’s board said that it has “no reason to believe” that either national security or company secrets were compromised. It also said that Huang “fully supports the review and has committed to cooperating with it,” and that the board has “confidence in Jensen and his leadership team.” The investigation will be conducted by independent directors working with outside legal counsel. In response to earlier reports about the CEO’s relationship with Alice Huang, Nvidia had said that the pair’s interactions were “not unusual,” and that the company does not share classified information with customers. Other companies involved in the AI boom have warned employees to be wary of possible spies , including those offering sex or romance. sources.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admits to having extramarital affair with suspected Chinese spy
sources.text: Nvidia Corp. said on Sunday it is launching an “independent investigation” into reports that its founder and Chief Executive Jensen Huang had been targeted by a foreign intelligence plot, shortly after he admitted he “had been intimate” with a Singapore-based executive who U.S. officials accuse of spying for China. In response to the allegations, the Republican-led foreign affairs and intelligence committee of the U.S. Congress has asked Huang (pictured, right) to testify this week at a closed-door briefing on the chipmaker’s “security protocols against foreign adversary espionage.” The request came after the New York Times reported last month that the CEO had been targeted in a Chinese espionage operation . The accused spy is a woman called Alice Huang or Huang Le (left), of no relation to the Nvidia CEO. Alice Huang is the CEO of a Singapore-based data center company called Megaspeed , which had previously been suspected of smuggling Nvidia’s high-end graphics processing units to China, prompting U.S. officials to begin monitoring her. Those officials have apparently determined that Alice Huang is an asset of the Chinese intelligence services, tasked with passing commercial secrets back to Beijing. In a statement earlier today, Nvidia’s board of directors said that while it has no reason to believe that either U.S. national security or the company’s secrets were compromised, its inquiry will examine all available information. “The Board prioritizes U.S. national and economic security, which is paramount to the interests of Nvidia and its shareholders,” the statement said. “The Board has confidence in Jensen and his leadership team and will provide further updates as appropriate.” The company added that Huang supports the investigation into what happened and has vowed to cooperate fully. A report by Axios earlier today cited a draft email written by Huang to company employees, in which he admitted to having an illicit romantic relationship with Alice Huang and took full responsibility for his actions. “I was unfaithful to my wife,” Huang wrote. “My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did.” U.S. intelligence chiefs will be concerned because Nvidia’s powerful chips sit at the center of the artificial intelligence boom and give America a critical advantage over its geopolitical rivals. The company’s dominance of AI computing means that Huang is one of the most influential people in the industry, and he has forged close ties with the Trump administration. The alleged spy reportedly tried to take advantage of Huang’s close links to America’s policymakers. Not only was she tasked with learning more about the company’s secrets, but also persuading Huang to lobby for the company to be allowed to ship its most advanced processors to China. It’s not clear how much influence she was able to exert on Huang, but last year he successfully petitioned the Trump administration to allow more GPUs to be exported to China. He later struck a deal to sell limited numbers of the company’s second-most powerful chips to China. So far, nothing has been said of Huang potentially losing his job or being removed from the company, but Yorkville Ives analyst Dan Ives told Gizmodo that such an outcome is possible . “This will add risk to the stock as he is so important to the Nvidia story and strategy globally,” the analyst said. The investigation follows a rough week for technology firms on Wall Street, which have weathered a sell-off that began earlier this month and gained traction after a series of disappointing earnings results in recent days. So far this month, the tech-heavy Nasdaq index has lost almost $1 trillion in value Nvidia’s stock has fallen 21% over the last month and is now basically flat in the year to date, with its market capitalization sitting at just over $4.5 trillion, down from its peak of just over $5.7 trillion in October 2026. sources.name: Canaltech
sources.title: Como usar o mapa do Gemini para encontrar novos lugares?
sources.text: Por Viviane França • Editado por Jones Oliveira | 07/11/2026 às 14:00 O Google lançou uma nova ferramenta chamada “Mapa” para o aplicativo Gemini em celulares. Com ela, você pode escolher uma região no mapa e pedir à inteligência artificial informações, recomendações e sugestões relacionadas ao local selecionado. A ferramenta é útil para quem quer encontrar restaurantes, pontos turísticos, lojas ou outros lugares de interesse sem precisar informar apenas o nome de uma cidade ou bairro. Ao abrir o recurso, o Gemini mostra um mapa da região atual do celular com uma área circular destacada . Você pode arrastar o mapa, aproximar ou afastar a visualização para posicionar a área sobre o local que deseja pesquisar. Também dá para procurar outro endereço ou região pelo ícone de lupa no canto superior direito. Depois de encontrar o local desejado, toque em “Explorar esta área”. O Gemini adiciona automaticamente a etiqueta “Área do Mapa” à caixa de texto, indicando que a região selecionada fará parte do contexto da conversa. A partir daí, é só fazer a pergunta ou enviar uma instrução, como pedir restaurantes próximos, pontos turísticos ou lugares interessantes para visitar. O recurso “Mapa” já está disponível nos aplicativos Gemini para Android e iOS , mas ainda não chegou à versão web. A ferramenta aparece no menu aberto pelo botão “+”, ao lado de opções Fotos, Câmera, Avatar, Arquivos, Drive e Notebooks. Caso você não queira adicionar uma região à conversa, basta tocar no botão “X” para fechar o mapa. Confira o passo a passo para começar a usar o mapa no Gemini: Deslize o carrossel de opções até encontrar “Mapa”; Permita que o Gemini acesse sua localização; Arraste o mapa e ajuste o zoom até encontrar a região desejada; Faça perguntas sobre o local ou peça sugestões de lugares para o Gemini. Se você gostou do conteúdo, talvez também se interesse por conferir “ 16 comandos para usar o Gemini no Google Maps ”.

sources.title: Cómo usar Gemini para encontrar, analizar y comparar productos antes de comprarlos
sources.text: Aplicaciones como ChatGPT, Claude o Gemini se han convertido en imprescindibles para millones de personas que buscan responder sus preguntas , obtener una explicación sobre algo que no entienden o, simplemente, obtener mejores resultados al buscar por internet . Y si hablamos de búsquedas online, muchas de ellas tienen que ver con comprar un producto o contratar un servicio . De ahí que existan tantos comparadores de viajes, telefonía, compañías eléctricas, electrónica o videojuegos. Es más. Comprar con Gemini o ChatGPT cada vez está más cerca de convertirse en una experiencia todo en uno. Este año hemos visto cómo Google ha ido incorporando elementos relacionados con las compras en sus productos y servicios . Como el carrito universal , que todavía no está presente en todos los países o las constantes mejoras del modo IA de Google y de Gemini enfocadas, precisamente a comprar por internet directamente desde su asistente de inteligencia artificial. Además, ya hemos visto con anterioridad que combinando Gemini y la cámara de tu móvil puedes organizar mejor tus compras . En este artículo vamos a ver de qué manera es posible comprar con Gemini . O, mejor dicho, qué cosas puedes pedirle a la IA de Google para ayudarte durante todo el proceso previo a la compra en sí. Por ejemplo, comparar precios, modelos del mismo producto, encontrar aquello que necesitas, inspirarte si no sabes qué regalar… En definitiva, Gemini puede ser un buen aliado y un asistente de compras si sabes cómo usarlo en tu favor. Comprar con Gemini puede resultar muy cómodo si sabes explicarle bien lo que necesitas . Primero, ¿sabes ya qué vas a comprar? Entonces, pídele que busque la tienda más barata. Si no estás seguro, pregúntale qué producto es mejor entre dos o tres que tengas en mente. Y si no tienes idea de lo que necesitas exactamente, expon tus necesidades y Gemini te dará las soluciones más aproximadas. Aquí van varios ejemplos de prompts sobre compras para empezar: En resumen, al buscar algo en Gemini, deberías tener en cuenta : Gemini nos da una plantilla para hacer una búsqueda de este tipo: “Quiero comprar [producto] para [uso concreto]. Presupuesto: [cantidad]. Debe cumplir: [requisitos imprescindibles]. Prefiero evitar: [restricciones]. Busca opciones disponibles en España, compáralas en una tabla con precio, especificaciones, ventajas, inconvenientes, garantía y reseñas. Después, dame X finalistas, señala riesgos y dime qué comprobaría yo mismo antes de pagar.” Hay muchos parámetros que te hacen decidirte por un producto. Según lo que sea, tal vez te interese lo económico . En otros casos, buscarás que dure mucho y se rompa poco . Otros productos te interesarán más por si tiene piezas de sustitución o recargables baratos . Y, muchas veces, tal vez quieras conocer qué te conviene más si hay que elegir entre que sea bueno, bonito o barato. Así que procura decírselo cuando busques qué comprar con Gemini. Por ejemplo, si vas a comprar algo tan genérico como un teléfono móvil y no tienes un candidato concreto, puedes preguntarle a Gemini que te muestra las mejores opciones según diferentes parámetros : los de mejor calidad, los más económicos, los que mejor combinen calidad-precio… Así, la IA te los mostrará en grupos comparando todas las opciones y te será más fácil decidirte por uno u otro. Las tablas son un elemento visual muy práctico cuando no te decides por un modelo concreto de ese producto que quieres comprar. Si tienes cuatro o cinco opciones a elegir, una tabla te resolverá las dudas. Así que díselo a Gemini, indicando que incluya parámetros como precio final, características más destacadas, dimensiones, peso, garantía… Según qué estés buscando comprar, puedes pedir mil y una cosas que te decantarán por una u otra opción. Materiales de fabricación, opinión de los usuarios y de los expertos, si cumple con los estándares o normativas… No des por sentado que Gemini te va a proporcionar toda la información que necesitas. Especifícalo tú mismo para que la tabla resultante sea lo más completa posible. Cuanto más caro es lo que quieres comprar, más tiempo le dedicarás a la búsqueda . Con Gemini ocurre igual. Si se trata de comprar con Gemini algo que te supondrá un desembolso considerable de dinero, te conviene utilizar la función Deep Research . En castellano, investigación profunda. Le llevará más tiempo a la IA darte una respuesta. Pero esa respuesta será un informe más preciso sobre lo que estás buscando. Y merece la pena. Además, en el modo Deep Research de Gemini puedes incluir tus propias fuentes . Por ejemplo, buscando tus propias fuentes en Google o subiendo archivos de manuales, prospectos, catálogos o folletos de productos. Así te asegurarás de que la IA busque donde tú quieres y te dé la información acorde a fuentes que tú consideres fiables o de confianza. Dedícale tiempo a esto antes de lanzar tu pregunta a Gemini y obtendrás mejores respuestas . Otra manera de ayudarte a decidirte entre dos o tres productos similares consiste en ver qué dicen los demás. Aunque las reseñas y opiniones tienen sus más y sus menos, y a veces hay que cogerlas con pinzas, pueden servir de ayuda. Así que pídele a Gemini que te diga qué opiniones merecen en internet determinado producto y si hay quejas o polémicas . Esto sirve tanto para el producto o servicio como para la tienda o proveedor del servicio . Hay tiendas y comercios en los que confiamos a ciegas. Pero es posible que encuentres un nuevo sitio con buenos precios que quieras probar. Si no lo conoces, necesitarás opiniones favorables que te hagan confiar en él. O, al contrario, que te libren de una mala experiencia. Pregunta si la compra es segura , si el envío es correcto, si hay atención al cliente , sede física, si el servicio posterior a la compra es el adecuado… Toda precaución es poca cuando se trata de comprar. I take full responsibility for what I did and the hurt I caused, and I accept the criticism that comes with it. To my wife and family: I love you. I know an apology cannot undo what I have done. I hope our family will heal and that, over time, I can earn back your trust. To my colleagues at NVIDIA, including those I have worked alongside for decades, and to our board, partners, and shareholders around the world: you deserve better from me. Leading NVIDIA is the privilege of my life. My responsibility is to serve you and be worthy of your trust. I have fallen short of that responsibility. I am fully committed to NVIDIA and will work to earn back your confidence. Regarding the national security concerns raised in news reports, NVIDIA's Board of Directors has initiated an independent investigation. I support the investigation and will cooperate fully. I love our country and our company. I am committed to protecting NVIDIA and supporting America's national security. I am proud and grateful to be an American. My family bears no responsibility for my choices. I do. Please give them privacy. — Jensen The NVIDIA Board is initiating an independent investigation in light of recent reporting that founder and CEO Jensen Huang has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort. A committee of independent directors, assisted by outside independent counsel, will oversee the investigation. The Board prioritizes U.S. national and economic security, which is paramount to the interests of NVIDIA and its shareholders. While the Board has no reason to believe that either national security or NVIDIA secrets were compromised, the Board's inquiry will examine all available information. Jensen fully supports the review and has committed to cooperating with it. The Board has confidence in Jensen and his leadership team and will provide further updates as appropriate.
